title: clap_complete: the dynamic completion engine (CompleteEnv)
takes: The shell calls the program itself, with COMPLETE=<shell> in the environment, and the program answers with candidates; functions attached to an argument give its values at runtime. A candidate function is handed only the word being typed: programs that need what was already said (a --root given earlier) parse the shell's line again by hand.

title: usage: a spec for command lines, in KDL
takes: One spec file gives shell completions, markdown docs and man pages; completions call back at runtime; an argument's allowed values may be built from a command that prints one value per line (choices run=); a line that does not parse prints no error over the prompt on Tab. A whole project of the same nature as argenv - arguments, flags, environment and config in one declaration.
